newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON TROUNCE NORTHERN TRANSVAAL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON TROUNCE NORTHERN TRANSVAAL.

text.p: Winger Tana Umaga scored three tries as the Wellington Hurricanes, beaten in their previous two matches, stormed to a 64-32 Super 12 rugby victory over the previously unbeaten Northern Transvaal on Sunday.
The home team, led by Mark Allen, thrashed the South African team eight tries to four in a non-stop action match.
It was the relentless wave of attacks by Wellington that buckled Northern Transvaal, much vaunted for their strong front eight.
The fact that front row forwards Allen and Norm Hewitt got on to the scoreboard reflected Wellington's all-round powerful game.
Flanker Martin Leslie, in superb form, scored two tries with the other Wellington five-pointer coming from replacement player Finau Maka, who was drafted into the side from Auckland.
Halfback Jon Preston kicked 22 points from four penalties and five conversions.
Wellington - Tries: T. Umaga (3), M. Leslie (2), M. Allen, N. Hewitt, F. Maka tries. Conversions: J. Preston (5), J. Cunningham. Penalties J. Preston (4).
Northern Transvaal: Tries: F. Meiring, S Bekker, J. Otto, penatly try. Conversions: T. van Rensburg (3). Penalties T. van Rensburg (2).
